Rare.name: Armed Changer
Rare.desc: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

Rare.name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
Rare.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Draw 1 card, plus another card if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect.

Rare.name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
Rare.desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card.

Rare.name: Chthonian Alliance
Rare.desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

Rare.name: Chthonian Blast
Rare.desc: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

Rare.name: Chthonian Soldier
Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

Rare.name: Feather Shot
Rare.desc: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

Rare.name: Hero Barrier
Rare.desc: Negate 1 attack from an opponent's monster. You must control a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster to resolve this effect.

Rare.name: Jack's Knight
Rare.desc: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

Rare.name: King's Knight
Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

Rare.name: Level Limit - Area A
Rare.desc: Change all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters to Attack Position.

Rare.name: Queen's Knight
Rare.desc: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

Rare.name: Rapid-Fire Magician
Rare.desc: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent each time you activate a Normal Spell Card.

Rare.name: Sillva, Warlord of Dark World
Rare.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard, then, if this card was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, your opponent returns exactly 2 cards from their hand to the bottom of their Deck, in any order.

Super Rare.name: B.E.S. Tetran
Super Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

Super Rare.name: Cyber Blader
Super Rare.desc:
"Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. While your opponent controls only 1 monster, this card cannot be destroyed by battle. While your opponent controls only 2 monsters, double this card's ATK. While your opponent controls only 3 monsters, negate the effects of your opponent's Spell, Trap, and Effect Monster Cards.

Super Rare.name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
Super Rare.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

Super Rare.name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
Super Rare.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: If it was discarded from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; Special Summon this card from the Graveyard, then destroy those targets (if any).

Super Rare.name: Pot of Avarice
Super Rare.desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

Super Rare.name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
Super Rare.desc:
"VW-Tiger Catapult" + "XYZ-Dragon Cannon"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's monster: You can target the attack target; change that attack target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

Super Rare.name: Water Dragon
Super Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

Common.name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
Common.desc: If this card is discarded to the Graveyard by a card effect: Special Summon it from the Graveyard.

Common.name: Blade Skater
Common.desc: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

Common.name: Bonding - H2O
Common.desc: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

Common.name: Boss Rush
Common.desc: You cannot Normal Summon or Set. During the End Phase of the turn that a "B.E.S." monster or a "Big Core" is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster or 1 "Big Core" from your Deck.

Common.name: Branch!
Common.desc: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

Common.name: Chthonian Polymer
Common.desc: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

Common.name: Dark Deal
Common.desc: When your opponent activates a Normal Spell Card: Pay 1000 Life Points; the effect of that Normal Spell Card becomes "Your opponent discards 1 random card".

Common.name: Dark World Lightning
Common.desc: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.

Common.name: Elemental HERO Wildheart
Common.desc: This card is unaffected by Trap effects.

Common.name: Etoile Cyber
Common.desc: If this card attacks your opponent directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

Common.name: Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Aussa the Earth Charmer" and 1 face-up EARTH monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Familiar-Possessed - Eria
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Eria the Water Charmer" and 1 face-up WATER monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Hiita the Fire Charmer" and 1 face-up FIRE monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Familiar-Possessed - Wynn
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Wynn the Wind Charmer" and 1 face-up WIND monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Feather Wind
Common.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated while you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian": Negate the activation and destroy it.

Common.name: Gateway to Dark World
Common.desc: Target 1 "Dark World" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

Common.name: Hydrogeddon
Common.desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

Common.name: Infernal Incinerator
Common.desc: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

Common.name: Level Modulation
Common.desc: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

Common.name: Nanobreaker
Common.desc: If this card attacks a face-up Level 3 or lower monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

Common.name: Non-Fusion Area
Common.desc: Neither player can Fusion Summon.

Common.name: Ojamagic
Common.desc: If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: Add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow" and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Ojamuscle
Common.desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Ojama" card.)
Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

Common.name: Oxygeddon
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.

Common.name: Reborn Zombie
Common.desc: While you have no cards in your hand and this card is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

Common.name: Roll Out!
Common.desc: Target 1 Union monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect.

Common.name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Simultaneous Loss
Common.desc: Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

Common.name: The Forces of Darkness
Common.desc: Target 2 "Dark World" monsters in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

Common.name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature
Common.desc: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster you control to activate this card. Special Summon as many cards as possible from your Deck with the same name as the selected monster.

Common.name: V-Tiger Jet
Common.desc: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

Common.name: VW-Tiger Catapult
Common.desc:
"V-Tiger Jet" + "W-Wing Catapult"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

Common.name: W-Wing Catapult
Common.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

Common.name: Weed Out
Common.desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy all face-up Attack Position Level 3 monsters.

Common.name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
Common.desc: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

Ultimate Rare.name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
Ultimate Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Clayman" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position, but only if your opponent controls no monsters, and if it does, this card's ATK is halved during damage calculation only.

Ultimate Rare.name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
Ultimate Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Flame Wingman" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your Graveyard. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard.

Ultimate Rare.name: Elemental HERO Tempest
Ultimate Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Bubbleman"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to target 1 monster you control; while this card is face-up on the field, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

Ultimate Rare.name: Elemental HERO Wildedge
Ultimate Rare.desc:
"Elemental HERO Wildheart" + "Elemental HERO Bladedge"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack every monster your opponent controls (one attack on each monster per Battle Phase).
